title: SR-3.05 The licences, stated once: Apache-2.0 core, BSL-1.1 crdt-merge, ACFA-RS under its own licence, commercial federated services
request: Closes G34, as amended by the owner decision of 31 Oct 2026: the engine licence was stated three ways (BSL 1.1, FSL-1.1-ALv2, draft BUSL-1.1 with licensor to be confirmed). The licences are now stated once, in docs/LICENSING-NOTICE.md, and every other mention agrees: the Memev core is Apache-2.0; crdt-merge is BSL 1.1 (its change date 2028-03-29 is unchanged and awaits lawyer review) with its PATENTS file; ACFA-RS is under its own licence; federated services are commercial and available by contact us. No licence file or term is changed by this contract. Signed vault contract WO-05-E (cited by id only) is the same deliverable: the licences stated once, with the signed text guard of the two licence pages left as it is. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.
